result.summary: The intersection is located in a residential area and features basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks and marked crosswalks. However, the lack of visible pedestrian signals and the presence of wide curb radii increase the risk for people crossing the street.

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible at the intersection, requiring pedestrians to interpret vehicular signals.
hazards.location_in_image: At the intersection corners.

hazards.name: Wide Curb Radius
hazards.description: The corner geometry is relatively wide, which can encourage higher vehicle speeds during right turns.
hazards.location_in_image: Right foreground corner.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signals with countdown timers to improve clarity and safety for crossing.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add bulb-outs to reduce the crossing distance and slow down turning traffic.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Upgrade the existing parallel line crosswalk markings to high-visibility continental patterns.

result.summary: The intersection is designed primarily for high-volume vehicle throughput, lacking basic pedestrian infrastructure such as sidewalks and dedicated signals. The wide roadway and absence of crossing aids create a high-exposure environment for anyone attempting to navigate the area on foot.

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalks
hazards.description: There are no paved walkways for pedestrians, forcing them to walk on the grass or the roadway shoulder.
hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the main roadway in the foreground and background.

hazards.name: Long Unprotected Crossing
hazards.description: The main road is very wide with no median refuge, increasing exposure time to high-speed traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the intersection across the main thoroughfare.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated walk/don't-walk signals are visible, requiring pedestrians to interpret vehicle signals.
hazards.location_in_image: At the signalized intersection.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct continuous paved sidewalks on both sides of the street to provide a dedicated, safe space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide roadway in two stages, reducing exposure.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add high-visibility crosswalk markings and pedestrian countdown signals to all legs of the intersection.

result.summary: The intersection features wide travel lanes and a lack of visible sidewalk infrastructure, creating a high-exposure environment for pedestrians. A large pickup truck in the foreground highlights significant sightline obstructions and potential for high-severity conflicts in this auto-oriented design.

hazards.name: Large Vehicle Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: The large pickup truck significantly blocks the view between drivers and pedestrians at the intersection.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground center

hazards.name: Wide Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The multi-lane roadway requires a long unprotected crossing time for pedestrians without a refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of image across the roadway

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The existing crosswalk markings are worn and may not be clearly visible to approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Roadway surface to the right of the truck

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Replace faded transverse lines with continental or ladder-style markings to increase visibility to motorists.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

result.summary: The intersection is heavily car-oriented, lacking marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals despite being controlled by traffic lights. Sidewalks are discontinuous or poorly defined, particularly on the right side of the image, creating a hostile environment for people walking.

hazards.name: Missing Crosswalks
hazards.description: No marked pedestrian crossings are visible at this signalized intersection, increasing the risk of vehicle-pedestrian conflict.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the foreground and mid-ground.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: The absence of pedestrian signal heads means walkers have no clear indication of when it is safe to cross relative to traffic phases.
hazards.location_in_image: On the utility and traffic light poles at the intersection corners.

hazards.name: Discontinuous Sidewalk Network
hazards.description: The sidewalk on the left is narrow and bounded by a fence, while the right side lacks a clearly defined, paved pedestrian path.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the edges of the roadway leading into the intersection.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks on all legs of the intersection to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide predictable crossing times for pedestrians.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Construct compliant curb ramps with detectable warning surfaces at all crossing points to ensure accessibility.
